cues: On that day in twenty fifteen, the ground shook at a particular frequency.
The buildings whose natural frequency matched the shaking were driven at resonance.
That one word is the answer: resonance.
It is why engineers now tune buildings, and add damping, to keep them away from it.
text: On that day in twenty fifteen, the ground shook at a particular frequency. The buildings whose natural frequency matched the shaking were driven at resonance. Their swings grew and grew. That one word is the answer: resonance. It is why engineers now tune buildings, and add damping, to keep them away from it.
